rule: When an optional provider dependency is experimental or not yet default, place it in a named extras group rather than in the mandatory dependencies list
trigger: pyproject.toml of a provider adds a new dependency that is experimental, a protocol upgrade (e.g. psycopg3), or explicitly described as optional
rationale: Adding an optional/experimental library as a hard dependency forces it onto all users of the provider; reviewers require it be gated behind an extras group so users opt in consciously

evidence.excerpt: add psycopg extra and move psycopg there; it's still experimental/optional

rule: Only pass new connection kwargs in a Hook when the user has explicitly provided them, to avoid breaking existing behaviour
trigger: a Hook's get_conn() or connection-building method unconditionally passes a new keyword argument that previously had no default
rationale: Unconditionally injecting new kwargs (e.g. catalog, source, query) into connection calls is a breaking change for existing users; reviewer requires guarding with 'only add if provided'

evidence.excerpt: catalog, source, query variables might introduce breaking change; only add kwargs if user provides

rule: Use module-level try/except ImportError to detect optional library availability in providers; do not import optional libraries inside hook or operator methods at call time
trigger: a provider hook or operator method contains a bare `import` or `from … import` statement for an optional third-party library inside a function body
rationale: Airflow's guideline keeps imports at module level; runtime imports inside provider functions violate this and cause repeated import overhead; use a module-level sentinel set once

evidence.excerpt: Importing DriverInfo inside get_conn() violates Airflow's guideline to keep imports at module level

rule: When embedding client-identification metadata, use the full provider package name (e.g. apache-airflow-providers-redis) rather than 'apache-airflow', so the version reported matches the component being identified
trigger: provider code sets a client library name or driver_info string to 'apache-airflow' while using `provider_version`
rationale: Reporting 'apache-airflow' with a provider version number misleads Redis (or other) admins; the name must match the versioned artefact — the provider package

evidence.excerpt: reports apache-airflow with provider_version, does not match actual Airflow versions; use provider package name

rule: Use the NOTSET sentinel to distinguish 'user explicitly passed None' from 'parameter not provided' in Airflow 2.x compatibility code paths
trigger: code in an Airflow-2.x compat branch checks `getattr(self, attr) is not None` or `!= None` to decide whether a parameter was supplied by the user
rationale: None is a valid user-supplied value; checking `is not NOTSET` is the correct Airflow idiom; using `is not None` causes false positives for default-None parameters

evidence.excerpt: getattr … is not NOTSET or None treats None as 'set'; note with default None reported as unsupported

rule: Do not set metadata["end_of_log"] = True when a log-fetch returns an empty result set; empty results may mean logs are not yet indexed, not that the task has finished logging
trigger: a task-log handler sets end_of_log to True inside an else/empty branch triggered by an empty logs_by_host or equivalent empty response
rationale: Prematurely marking end_of_log stops UI polling/streaming before task logs are available; the existing missing-log timeout logic should determine when to end

evidence.excerpt: marks log complete even when no lines returned; logs not indexed yet; can prematurely stop UI polling

rule: When an optional SQLAlchemy or provider feature is unavailable at runtime, emit a warning rather than raising AirflowOptionalProviderFeatureException, so the method can still return partial results from the SQL parser
trigger: an except ImportError block inside a provider method raises AirflowOptionalProviderFeatureException for a missing optional dependency that the surrounding method can partially work around
rationale: Raising an exception aborts the entire method; a warning preserves partial functionality (e.g. sql_parser results) when only the optional SQLAlchemy path is unavailable

evidence.excerpt: should not raise but warn; method should work fine without sqlalchemy

rule: Every new authentication branch added to a Hook's _init_conn() or get_conn() must have a dedicated unit test asserting the correct client initialisation
trigger: a provider Hook adds a new auth branch (e.g. oauth_token, api_key, certificate) with no corresponding test case covering that branch
rationale: New auth code paths that are untested can silently regress or fall back to incorrect auth modes; reviewers require explicit coverage for each supported auth strategy

evidence.excerpt: new oauth_token branch in _init_conn() not covered; add test with extra={"oauth_token": …}

rule: The @provide_session enforcement script must check both posonlyargs and args when detecting a positional session parameter
trigger: the check_provide_session_kwargs CI script's positional-detection function inspects only args.args and omits args.posonlyargs
rationale: A def f(session, /, …) signature places session in posonlyargs; omitting that field means the script silently misses violations and the @provide_session keyword-only invariant is not enforced

evidence.excerpt: ignores posonlyargs; def f(session, /, …) not flagged; check both posonlyargs and args

rule: OpenLineage DAG-run conf integration must strongly encourage all six parent and root ID fields; document that omitting root info is discouraged when the consumer supports ParentRunFacet 1.1.0
trigger: documentation for the _openlineage conf dict lists parent/root fields as fully optional without noting the strong preference for providing all six when using ParentRunFacet 1.1.0
rationale: There is no point in not providing root info when the downstream consumer understands ParentRunFacet 1.1.0; docs should strongly encourage completeness

evidence.excerpt: strongly encourage all six; no point not providing root info when using ParentRunFacet 1.1.0
